title: Launcher lightbox, slice one: the launch opens full screen with a Pause close, and /spaces/new is one front door

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-29: persistent full-screen launcher, Pause not a hard exit, one Spotlight per Space

detail: Slice one of the launcher and Setup plan. Every launch page opens as the shared Dialog at align=overlay (focus trap, Esc, scroll lock). Pause returns to the page the person came from. With LAUNCH_SYSTEM_ENABLED on, /spaces/new starts the launch for everyone instead of showing the five-step form in the rail to anyone with no launch under way. Later slices: entry-aware start step (at=), intent screen (personal Spotlight, business, both), the persistent Finish setup button and panel, hide with two confirmations, products shelf, and the Setup registry built from SPACE_MODULES.

verify.evidence: The launch layout wraps pages in LaunchLightbox and /spaces/new starts the launch.
